metadata.title: fix: improve test coverage and resolve xdist RBAC test failures
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- **Fix RBAC test failures under xdist**: E2e test modules (`test_main_apis.py`, `test_oauth_protected_resource.py`) replace `rbac.require_permission` etc. with noop decorators at module import time without cleanup. When xdist assigns these to the same worker as `test_rbac.py`, 14 tests fail with "DID NOT RAISE" or "Called 0 times". Added an `autouse` fixture using `importlib.reload(rbac)` to restore real decorator implementations while preserving the `PermissionService` mock from conftest.

- **Improve test coverage across auth modules**:
  - `auth.py` → 99% (3 dead code lines remaining)
  - `oauth_manager.py` → 100% (from 86%)
  - `auth_middleware.py` → 100%
  - `auth_cache.py` → 100%
  - `email_auth.py` → 100%
  - `http_auth_middleware.py` → 98%
  - Additional coverage for `rbac.py`, gRPC client, LLM proxy service, email auth router, LLM config router

## Test plan

- [x] All 51 RBAC tests pass individually
- [x] All RBAC tests pass with xdist (`-n auto`) alongside e2e tests that pollute decorator state
- [x] Coverage targets verified with `pytest --cov --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing`
- [x] No regressions in existing tests

commits.message:
fix: resolve xdist test failures from RBAC decorator pollution

E2e test modules (test_main_apis.py, test_oauth_protected_resource.py)
replace rbac decorators with noop versions at module import time without
cleanup. When xdist assigns these to the same worker as unit tests, the
decorators stay as no-ops permanently, causing test failures across
test_rbac.py, test_main.py, and test_admin_catalog_htmx.py.

Save original RBAC decorator functions at conftest import time (before
any test module can patch them) and restore them via monkeypatch in the
existing autouse fixture. This preserves function identity (avoiding
dependency_overrides mismatches) and protects all unit tests under
tests/unit/mcpgateway/.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
